source_research: Founder-approved v0.3 research synthesized into this asset; source pack is not a Cursor implementation input
production_baseline: embedded certification catalogue v0.1 (10 rows), existing scoring untouched

dynamic_update_contract.add: new ID plus explicitly assigned treatment and approved terms; default nonselectable
dynamic_update_contract.modify: publish new version; preserve prior identity and submitted evidence; no retroactive reinterpretation
dynamic_update_contract.retire: set search_visible false and selectable false in new version; preserve historical ID and existing evidence; no destructive deletion
dynamic_update_contract.revoke_artwork: disable render immediately via approved registry update; text fallback
dynamic_update_contract.admission: never from alias matching alone; existing explicit selection and Evidence Authority
dynamic_update_contract.change_control: founder-governed catalogue update; no Cursor-generated editorial or policy changes

runtime_search_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, trim, collapse whitespace, ignore punctuation for retrieval only; preserve raw packet wording
runtime_search_contract.selectable_action: Only selectable_existing rows offer Select; require deliberate tap
runtime_search_contract.unapproved_action: Display as informational matching wording only, with Add exact wording as unresolved; do not create canonical certification id
runtime_search_contract.unmatched_action: Add exact packet wording as unresolved via existing governed contribution path
runtime_search_contract.scoring: no new routes; existing production ID mapping only
runtime_search_contract.source_evidence: research vocabulary is not product evidence
runtime_search_contract.broad_terms: Suggestions must not suppress or outrank the verbatim Add wording action; broad terms cannot auto-identify a certification
runtime_search_contract.proposal_reuse: future OCR/VLM proposals use same selectable identity and verbatim text review path; machine never self-admits

consumer_interaction_contract.surface: Existing Packet information modal; no separate certification versus ordinary claim mode
consumer_interaction_contract.entry: One persistent input accepts any literal packet claim or certification mark wording
consumer_interaction_contract.suggestions: Nonblocking certification suggestions appear as the consumer types; show distinguishing name/variant and context; never auto-select
consumer_interaction_contract.free_text: Always offer Add wording from pack using the exact user-entered string, even when suggestions exist; no certified/noncertified labels required
consumer_interaction_contract.selection: Explicit tap on approved selectable identity only; show selected canonical identity, preserve literal typed wording separately
consumer_interaction_contract.nonselectable_discovery: Never display as Select certification; allow verbatim Add wording from pack, with no identity assignment
consumer_interaction_contract.repeat: After each Add, clear input, retain list and focus-ready Add another; no artificial count cap
consumer_interaction_contract.review: List all entries individually, with Edit and Remove; prevent accidental duplicate submissions without collapsing distinct literal observations
consumer_interaction_contract.submit: One Submit packet information for one or many entries, using existing Evidence Authority; partial participation permitted
consumer_interaction_contract.recovery: Restore pending entries and associated visible photos after reopening; do not imply submission succeeded before admission
consumer_interaction_contract.future_extraction: OCR/VLM fills candidate entries into same list, subject to targeted correction and informed submission; manual remains always available
consumer_interaction_contract.visual: Single input; suggestions beneath; Add wording action always discoverable; selected list beneath; one submission CTA; usable with mobile keyboard, long lists and accessibility labels
